simulation.method: 100 runs: 5 stages × 5 seeds × automatic/first/middle/last draft choice. Up to 360 seconds at 120Hz, ordinary movement, assist, fire, source and boost commands. Manual choices use actual draft candidates. No forced clear, life refill or artificial stats. Not human enjoyment or purchase evidence.

veteran.method: 45 ordinary input runs, 120Hz movement/fire and aim each 14 ticks; frame choice and intermission evolution through engine methods; no forced wins or life refill. Not a human win-rate measurement.

campaign.method: 12 fresh-account campaigns, guide +3P and initial 5P only; waves/bosses earn progression, upgrades consume earned parts, earned gems only. 120Hz ordinary command simulation, three same-seed attempts maximum with guided recovery. No state-forced wins, life refill or unlocked stage skip. Not human engagement/purchase evidence.

browserAgency.method: Three viewport browser tests with ordinary accelerated engine inputs and real UI selection, checkpoint and reload. Separate automatic setting test. No forced clear or life refill.

rows.name: automatic
checks: real setting enables automatic valid tuning

browserJourney.method: Browser flows at three viewports, combat accelerated with ordinary engine commands and real app event/reward handling; no forced victory or seed/life edits. Not human usability or frame-rate evidence.
